name.str_pl: copies of the Book of Vile Darkness

description: A 3rd Edition D&D supplement that adds a bunch of extremely evil things. Intended as a GM only tool, this book contains "a large amount of new game material—all of it vile, loath- some, dark, and despicable. Although evil monsters, spells, and magic items have appeared in previous products, this compendium is a collection of the most vile, hideous, and disgusting aspects of evil that might appear in a game. Its pages contain references to acts of horrible depravity and malevolent behavior unlike anything you have probably encountered before in D&D." The overly grimdark-adjescent content might be a turnoff considering current circumstances.
//: Have you held one of these things? Bastards have some real weight behind 'em

name.str_pl: copies of the Book of Erotic Fantasy

description: From the title, you'd think this book was a titillating guide to sex positions. In actuality, its an unofficial expansion for 3rd edition Dungeons and Dragons, that added sexual content. Its not as bad as FATAL, and with it being the apocalypse, social conventions like modesty have collapsed enough you might be able to get away with using content from it in your campaigns... If you can find a group and/or polycule.
//: Have you held one of these things? Bastards have some real weight behind 'em
